```yaml
name: Smoke tests Mastodon

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
      - next
      - '*.*-maintenance'
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  smoke-mastodon:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 60
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Verify Docker Compose
        run: docker compose version

      - name: Start Mastodon stack and test harness
        run: |
          docker compose -f test/smoke/mastodon/docker-compose.yml up -d

      - name: Wait for services to be healthy
        run: |
          for i in {1..30}; do
            if curl -s http://localhost:3000/_test/health | grep -q "ok"; then
              echo "Services are ready"
              break
            fi
            echo "Waiting for services... ($i)"
            sleep 5
          done

      - name: Set up Deno
        uses: denoland/setup-deno@v1
        with:
          deno-version: v1.x

      - name: Run E2E orchestrator
        run: deno run --allow-net --allow-env test/smoke/orchestrator.ts
        env:
          MASTODON_URL: http://localhost:4000
          FEDIFY_URL: http://localhost:3000

      - name: Publish test results
        uses: dorny/test-reporter@v1
        with:
          name: 'Smoke tests'
          path: test-results.xml
          reporter: jest-junit

      - name: Stop services
        if: always()
        run: docker compose -f test/smoke/mastodon/docker-compose.yml down
```
